title: 猫和老鼠
summary: 无向图中老鼠从一、猫从二开始轮流移动，老鼠到零获胜、猫追上老鼠获胜，重复状态视为平局，双方最优时返回结果。
insight: 对状态 (mouse,cat,turn) 做逆向拓扑：先标终局；若某父状态的当前玩家能走到自己的胜局就立即获胜，否则当所有可走后继都对其不利时判为对手胜。
pitfalls: 状态还必须包含轮到谁
未知状态最终就是平局零

solutions.title: 博弈状态逆向 BFS
solutions.idea: 从已知输赢状态向所有可能父状态传播。
steps: 初始化 mouse=0 为鼠胜、mouse=cat 为猫胜；degree 为当前玩家合法移动数
队列弹 child，枚举上一步可能的 parent
若 parent 当前玩家可选择 child 并获胜，则标同结果；否则 degree[parent]--，归零时标为对手胜；返回 outcome[1][2][mouseTurn]

code.java: class Solution { public int catMouseGame(int[][] graph){int n=graph.length;int[][][] outcome=new int[n][n][2],degree=new int[n][n][2];for(int m=0;m<n;m++)for(int c=1;c<n;c++){degree[m][c][0]=graph[m].length;int catMoves=0;for(int next:graph[c])if(next!=0)catMoves++;degree[m][c][1]=catMoves;}Queue<int[]> queue=new ArrayDeque<>();for(int c=1;c<n;c++)for(int turn=0;turn<2;turn++){outcome[0][c][turn]=1;queue.offer(new int[]{0,c,turn,1});}for(int m=1;m<n;m++)for(int turn=0;turn<2;turn++){outcome[m][m][turn]=2;queue.offer(new int[]{m,m,turn,2});}while(!queue.isEmpty()){int[] state=queue.poll();int m=state[0],c=state[1],turn=state[2],result=state[3];if(turn==0){for(int previousCat:graph[c])if(previousCat!=0)propagate(m,previousCat,1,result,outcome,degree,queue);}else for(int previousMouse:graph[m])propagate(previousMouse,c,0,result,outcome,degree,queue);}return outcome[1][2][0];}private void propagate(int m,int c,int turn,int childResult,int[][][] outcome,int[][][] degree,Queue<int[]> queue){if(outcome[m][c][turn]!=0)return;int playerWin=turn==0?1:2;if(childResult==playerWin){outcome[m][c][turn]=childResult;queue.offer(new int[]{m,c,turn,childResult});}else if(--degree[m][c][turn]==0){int result=turn==0?2:1;outcome[m][c][turn]=result;queue.offer(new int[]{m,c,turn,result});}} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun catMouseGame(graph:Array<IntArray>):Int{val n=graph.size;val outcome=Array(n){Array(n){IntArray(2)}};val degree=Array(n){Array(n){IntArray(2)}};for(m in 0 until n)for(c in 1 until n){degree[m][c][0]=graph[m].size;degree[m][c][1]=graph[c].count{it!=0}};val queue=java.util.ArrayDeque<IntArray>();for(c in 1 until n)for(turn in 0..1){outcome[0][c][turn]=1;queue.addLast(intArrayOf(0,c,turn,1))};for(m in 1 until n)for(turn in 0..1){outcome[m][m][turn]=2;queue.addLast(intArrayOf(m,m,turn,2))};while(queue.isNotEmpty()){val state=queue.removeFirst();val m=state[0];val c=state[1];val turn=state[2];val result=state[3];if(turn==0){for(previousCat in graph[c])if(previousCat!=0)propagate(m,previousCat,1,result,outcome,degree,queue)}else for(previousMouse in graph[m])propagate(previousMouse,c,0,result,outcome,degree,queue)};return outcome[1][2][0]};private fun propagate(m:Int,c:Int,turn:Int,childResult:Int,outcome:Array<Array<IntArray>>,degree:Array<Array<IntArray>>,queue:java.util.ArrayDeque<IntArray>){if(outcome[m][c][turn]!=0)return;val playerWin=if(turn==0)1 else 2;if(childResult==playerWin){outcome[m][c][turn]=childResult;queue.addLast(intArrayOf(m,c,turn,childResult))}else if(--degree[m][c][turn]==0){val result=if(turn==0)2 else 1;outcome[m][c][turn]=result;queue.addLast(intArrayOf(m,c,turn,result))}} }
code.cpp: class Solution { void propagate(int m,int c,int turn,int childResult,vector<vector<array<int,2>>>& outcome,vector<vector<array<int,2>>>& degree,queue<array<int,4>>& pending){if(outcome[m][c][turn])return;int playerWin=turn==0?1:2;if(childResult==playerWin){outcome[m][c][turn]=childResult;pending.push({m,c,turn,childResult});}else if(--degree[m][c][turn]==0){int result=turn==0?2:1;outcome[m][c][turn]=result;pending.push({m,c,turn,result});}}public:int catMouseGame(vector<vector<int>>& graph){int n=graph.size();vector<vector<array<int,2>>> outcome(n,vector<array<int,2>>(n,{0,0})),degree(n,vector<array<int,2>>(n,{0,0}));for(int m=0;m<n;++m)for(int c=1;c<n;++c){degree[m][c][0]=graph[m].size();for(int next:graph[c])degree[m][c][1]+=next!=0;}queue<array<int,4>> pending;for(int c=1;c<n;++c)for(int turn=0;turn<2;++turn){outcome[0][c][turn]=1;pending.push({0,c,turn,1});}for(int m=1;m<n;++m)for(int turn=0;turn<2;++turn){outcome[m][m][turn]=2;pending.push({m,m,turn,2});}while(!pending.empty()){auto state=pending.front();pending.pop();int m=state[0],c=state[1],turn=state[2],result=state[3];if(turn==0){for(int previousCat:graph[c])if(previousCat)propagate(m,previousCat,1,result,outcome,degree,pending);}else for(int previousMouse:graph[m])propagate(previousMouse,c,0,result,outcome,degree,pending);}return outcome[1][2][0];} };
